newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plummeted 2.65 percent on Monday amid settlement day profit-taking spurred by falling rates of global depositary receipts of PTCL and Hub Power Co, dealers said.
They said the market gave a cautious response to Sunday's speech by Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif amid uncertainty about the economic impact of the measures he announced.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 46.41 points to close at 1,703.28 with 263 losers and 100 gainers. PTCL fell 2.70 rupees to 30.40 rupees and Hub Power Co 1.05 to 40.75.
